description:
Adopt the dedicated emulator service in scenario-to-desktop and deployment-manager so those scenarios stop directly owning the shared live-desktop validation stack wherever reasonable.

The goal is to preserve human-gated sanity checks while consolidating emulator behavior into one shared service that can later grow beyond Linux.
name: adopt-vrooli-emulator-in-deployment-flows
title: Adopt The Emulator Service In Deployment Flows
